study_design: Prospective cohort study of California Seventh-Day Adventist men
cohort_total_n_excerpt: A prospective study with 225 incident cases of prostate cancer in 12,395 California Seventh-Day Adventist men who in 1976 stated how often they drank soy milk.
reason: The prospective study evaluated incident prostate cancer overall. The abstract does not analyze an aggressive, advanced, metastatic, high-grade, or lethal incident endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Frequent consumption (more than once a day) of soy milk was associated with 70 per cent reduction of the risk of prostate cancer (relative risk = 0.3, 95 percent confidence interval 0.1-1.0, p-value for linear trend = 0.03).
estimate_classifications.reason: This estimate concerns overall incident prostate cancer, with no aggressive disease restriction.
